ruthenium.options.blockEntityCulling.too: Skips each block entity outside the view, instead of drawing every block entity of a partly visible chunk section.
ruthenium.options.retainedChests.tooltip: Keeps the geometry of block entities at rest (closed chests and shulker boxes, decorated pots, skulls, sign text, lecterns, bells, copper golem statues) on the GPU across frames instead of rebuilding it every frame.
ruthenium.options.retainedChangeChecks.t: When blocks or light change near retained block entities (crops, grass, redstone), their geometry is only rebuilt if their blocks or light changed. Needs Retained Block Entities.
ruthenium.options.instancedModels.toolti: Draws closed enchanting table books and armor stands posed alike as GPU instances.
ruthenium.options.modelBackFaceCulling.t: Leaves out entity and block entity faces, and sign text, that face away from the camera on the CPU. The GPU would discard them anyway.
ruthenium.options.transparentFaceCulling: Leaves out the faces of entity models whose texture is fully transparent there (spider and enderman eyes, horse markings, ...). They draw nothing. Reads those textures from the resource packs once.
ruthenium.options.particleSpawnLimit.too: Drops new particles when there are already as many as the game can show, instead of queueing them to be discarded later.
ruthenium.options.terrainFaceCulling.too: Skips the block faces of a chunk section that all point away from the camera, which the GPU would discard anyway. Changing it reloads the chunks.
ruthenium.options.compressedTerrain.tool: Stores solid and cutout block vertices in 20 instead of 28 bytes, so the GPU reads less memory per frame. Changing it reloads the chunks.
ruthenium.options.sectionLightCache.tool: Builds chunks faster: smooth lighting reads each block's light once per chunk section instead of through a small cache that keeps forgetting it. The lighting is identical.
ruthenium.options.sectionStateCache.tool: Builds chunks faster: the blocks around each block (for hidden faces and smooth lighting) are read from a flat array instead of the chunk's compressed storage. The chunks look identical.
ruthenium.options.biomeBlendCache.toolti: Builds chunks faster: biome colour blending (grass, leaves, water) looks up each column's biome once per chunk section instead of once for every block around it. The colours are identical.
ruthenium.options.skipIdleTicks.tooltip: Skips ticking closed chests and signs nobody is editing, whose ticks do nothing.
ruthenium.options.parkIdleTickers.toolti: Idle chests, shulker boxes and signs leave the list of block entities the game goes through every tick until they open or get edited, instead of being checked and skipped every tick. Needs Skip Idle Block Entity Ticks.
ruthenium.options.cacheTickerStates.tool: Block entities that animate every tick (enchanting tables, ...) look up and check their block once after it changes instead of before every tick.
ruthenium.options.batchTableTicks.toolti: Enchanting tables animate their books in one loop that looks for nearby players once per tick, instead of each table going through the list of ticking block entities and searching the players. Needs Park Idle Block Entities and Fast Block Entity Ticks.
ruthenium.options.fastEntityCulling.tool: Tests entities against the view without allocating boxes or looking up their renderer, with the same result. Mods that change entity culling by hooking Minecraft's culling methods may want it off.
ruthenium.options.entityLightCache.toolt: Entities keep the light level at their position from one frame to the next until they move to another block or the world's light changes, instead of looking it up every frame.
ruthenium.options.fastEntityCollisions.t: Moving entities look for entities to collide with (boats, shulkers) only in the parts of the world that contain such entities, instead of checking every entity around them. Same collisions.
ruthenium.options.fastAnimateTick.toolti: The tick that picks random blocks around you for particles and sounds (torches, leaves, biome particles) skips biome lookups where no biome has ambient particles and draws its random numbers faster. Same particles.
ruthenium.options.fastBoatTicks.tooltip: Boats check the blocks under them and the players they push with less work each tick. Same results.
ruthenium.options.fastSupportingBlocks.t: Dropped items and experience orbs lying on the ground remember the block they rest on until a block near them changes, instead of searching for it every tick. Same results.
ruthenium.options.reuseEntityStates.tool: Armor stands reuse their render state from the previous frame instead of creating a new one every frame.
ruthenium.options.blockModelMeshCache.to: Item frames, block displays, minecarts and endermen reuse the quads of their block models instead of building them again every frame.
ruthenium.options.hashedDrawLookup.toolt: Finds the draw an entity's or item's geometry goes into with a hash lookup instead of searching all of the frame's draws.
ruthenium.options.mergeDraws.tooltip: Puts entity and item geometry with the same texture and settings into one draw call, as vanilla intends but never does. Turn off if a mod's entity overlays flicker or disappear.
ruthenium.options.instancedParts.tooltip: Keeps the shape of every mob body part on the GPU and only sends each part's position per frame, instead of all of its corners. Turn off if a mod's mobs look wrong.
ruthenium.options.reuseLayerPoses.toolti: Layers that draw a mob's model again (villager clothing, spider and enderman eyes, horse markings, collars) reuse the poses of its parts instead of posing the model again. Only for Minecraft's own models.
ruthenium.options.instancedArmor.tooltip: Draws worn armor, saddles and horse armor like the mob parts under Instanced Mob Parts (which must be on). Turn off if armor or armor trims look wrong.
ruthenium.options.instancedBlockModels.t: Keeps the shape of blocks shown by entities (item frames, block displays, blocks in minecarts) on the GPU and only sends each one's position per frame. Turn off if such blocks look wrong.
ruthenium.options.instancedItems.tooltip: Keeps the shape of every item model on the GPU and only sends each item's position per frame, for dropped items, items in frames, held items and item displays. Turn off if a mod's items look wrong.
ruthenium.options.directBakedQuads.toolt: Dropped, held and framed items write the four vertices of each quad at once instead of one vertex at a time.
